A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed and validated a method to estimate the microscopic g‐ratios of white matter fibers in vivo.
the g‐ratio is a useful biomarker for the study of white matter integrity, and that it can be measured in vivo with high repeatability and comparable results between subjects.
